headline_outcome: Own Your Space. No More Leases.
primary_text: "Our lease is up in 12 months and the landlord wants a 30% increase or we're out." This is the reality for small businesses across Melbourne's west right now. Landlords know you have nowhere to go, and they're squeezing hard. What if you never had to negotiate a lease again? Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina give you certainty — your own space, your own terms, forever. 20km from Melbourne CBD near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Stop begging your landlord for mercy. Start planning your future.
description: Never negotiate a lease again — own your warehouse outright in Truganina
